name: CodeCrafters Club
tagline: Building the next generation of software innovators and competitive coders.
description: CodeCrafters is the premier coding and software development society at UNIVO. We host regular algorithmic bootcamps, open-source sprints, web/app hackathons, and developer meetups to prepare students for top tech roles.
objectives: Foster competitive programming and algorithmic problem-solving excellence
Guide students in building production-ready open source projects
Organize HackUNIVO, the annual 36-hour national collegiate hackathon
Host peer-to-peer interview preparation sessions and system design workshops
activities: Weekly LeetCode & Codeforces contests with faculty mentorship
Hands-on AI/ML and Cloud Native application development bootcamps
Annual HackUNIVO National Hackathon with industry sponsors
Open-Source October: Guiding 100+ first-time PRs

name: RoboVortex Robotics Society
tagline: Designing, building, and programming intelligent autonomous systems.
description: RoboVortex unites hardware tinkerers, embedded systems developers, and AI robotics enthusiasts. Members work on autonomous drones, line followers, combat robots, and IoT micro-grid controllers.
objectives: Train students in ROS (Robot Operating System), embedded C, and CAD modeling
Build combat-ready robots for national Robowars championships
Develop autonomous aerial drones for smart campus monitoring
Partner with automotive and automation industries for internships
activities: RoboWars Campus Arena Battles
Autonomous Line-Follower and Maze-Solver Contests
Arduino & Raspberry Pi Beginner Bootcamp for 1st-year students
Industrial automation site visits

name: Dhwani Music Society
tagline: Celebrating melodies, classical traditions, and contemporary fusion rhythms.
description: Dhwani is the official music society of UNIVO, comprising vocalists, instrumentalists, percussionists, and sound production engineers. We represent the university at inter-collegiate cultural fests nationwide.
objectives: Provide a welcoming space for musicians across classical, rock, jazz, and pop
Represent UNIVO in youth festivals and national Battle of the Bands
Train students in audio production, sound mixing, and studio acoustics
Organize acoustic jam sessions and open mic nights
activities: Annual Inter-University Battle of the Bands
Acoustic Sunset Jams at the Central Amphitheatre
Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) and logic-mixing masterclasses
Collaborative soundtrack composition for student short films

name: Natraj Dance Troupe
tagline: Expressing passion, rhythm, and storytelling through classical and modern dance.
description: Natraj is UNIVO's award-winning dance troupe, known for spellbinding choreographies spanning Western hip-hop, classical Bharatanatyam, contemporary lyrical, and high-energy folk dances.
venue: Mirrored Dance Studio, Student Activity Centre
objectives: Promote dance education, body flexibility, and stage confidence
Compete at premier cultural festivals like Mood Indigo and Oasis
Create socially relevant dance theatrical productions
Encourage cross-genre choreography and artistic experimentation
activities: Annual Dance Production: Mudra
Campus flashmobs for mental health and social causes
Western Hip-Hop and Locking/Popping intensives
Inter-branch dance faceoffs during freshers week

name: Titan Strikers Sports Club
tagline: Champions on the field, leaders in life. Fostering collegiate athletic excellence.
description: Titan Strikers oversees varsity teams and intramural leagues for football, basketball, cricket, badminton, volleyball, and track events. We promote physical fitness, team discipline, and collegiate sportsmanship.
venue: University Central Sports Complex & Floodlit Turf
objectives: Prepare varsity athletes for All India Inter-University Tournaments
Conduct competitive semester sports leagues across departments
Maintain modern gym and training facilities for student fitness
Foster sportsmanship, team resilience, and mental well-being
activities: UNIVO Premier League (Cricket & Football Tournaments)
Intramural Badminton and Table Tennis Championships
Annual Campus Marathon for Heart Health
Strength and conditioning clinics with certified trainers

name: E-Cell (Entrepreneurship Cell)
tagline: Igniting student startup ideas, venture mentoring, and seed funding support.
description: E-Cell empowers ambitious student entrepreneurs to take their ideas from napkin sketches to venture-backed companies. We provide incubation resources, founder meetups, angel investor connections, and legal support.

facultyCoordinator.name: Dr. Vikram Sethi
facultyCoordinator.office: Startup Incubator, Ground Floor, Admin Block

objectives: Cultivate an entrepreneurial mindset and business literacy among students
Connect aspiring founders with angel investors, VCs, and alumni founders
Facilitate prototyping grants and intellectual property filing assistance
Host the annual UNIVO E-Summit, one of northern India's premier student conclaves
activities: Campus Shark Tank Seed Grant Pitch Competition
Founder Fireside Chats with Unicorn CEOs
Startup Legal, Compliance, and Equity Masterclasses
Summer Incubator Cohort with equity-free seed grants

name: Sparsh Social Service Society
tagline: Empathy in action. Community outreach, child education, and green initiatives.
description: Sparsh is UNIVO's volunteer-driven social welfare society. We run weekend evening schools for underprivileged children, conduct mega blood donation camps, lead reforestation drives, and support disaster relief funds.
meetingSchedule: Every Friday, 4:00 PM - 5:30 PM & Weekend Outreach
objectives: Provide free evening tutoring and digital literacy to disadvantaged children
Organize bi-annual blood donation drives with the Indian Red Cross
Drive campus zero-waste, plastic-ban, and tree plantation campaigns
Sensitize students toward civic duties, empathy, and social equality
activities: Project Gyan: Weekend tutoring sessions for 120+ village students
Annual Mega Blood Donation Drive collecting 400+ units
Campus Cleanliness and Lake Rejuvenation Drives
Winter Blanket and Book Donation Campaigns

name: Aperture Photography & Film Club
tagline: Capturing campus moments, cinematic storytelling, and visual arts.
description: Aperture is the official visual arts, cinematography, and photography society of UNIVO. We document campus life, produce high-production short films, and train students in camera optics, lighting, and color grading.
objectives: Master DSLR and mirrorless camera operations, lighting, and composition
Produce the official UNIVO Annual Cinematic Showcase documentary
Train students in Adobe Premiere Pro, Lightroom, and DaVinci Resolve
Organize inter-college photography exhibitions and photowalks
activities: 48-Hour Campus Short Film Contest
Old City Heritage Street Photowalk
Cinematic Lighting and Color Grading Workshop
Official media coverage for UNIVO festivals and sports meets
